class.name: NNSensorGroup
class.brief_description: Aggregates input from several sensors (or sensor groups) for a higher-level input to the consideration nodes.
class.description: This node type should be added as child nodes of the [NNAgent] node. It is used to give input data to consideration nodes. A sensor is used by one or more consideration nodes. A sensor group is a node that can be used to aggregate input from several sensors (or sensor groups) for a higher-level input to the consideration nodes.

members.member: How the child sensors and sensor groups are aggregated into [member NNSensors.sensor_value]. The default is [constant NoodleNodes.EVALUATION_MEAN].
This inverts the group sensor_value by calculating: [code]sensor_value = 1.0 - sensor_value[/code]. It is applied after all the child nodes have been evaluated.
